apps.localizedDescription:
YouTube with Shorts permanently removed.

The NoShortsEver tweak unconditionally strips:
• The Shorts button in the navigation bar
• Shorts shelves and cells in feeds, search results, and channels
• Any Short that still opens is reopened in the normal video player

Base YouTube 21.20.4 with YTLite 5.2.2 (ad-blocking, background playback, sideload identity spoofing).
apps.versionDescription: KNOWN-GOOD build: YouTube 21.20.4 + YTLite 5.2.2 + NoShortsEver + YTABConfig 1.9.2. Playback and sign-in both work when signed in via an account already on the device.
